main_block: Superset 1: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-065 | Leg Press] 4 sets of 10 reps, moderate to heavy load, controlled push and slow return
Exercise B: [IMF-054 | Single-Leg Glute Bridge] 4 sets of 12 reps each side, focus on full hip extension at the top
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 2: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-082 | Leg Extension] 3 sets of 12 reps, squeeze at the top of each rep
Exercise B: [IMF-028 | Plank, Forearms] 3 sets of 30 seconds, brace the core and breathe steadily
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 3: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-098 | Seated Leg Curl] 3 sets of 12 reps, slow and controlled on the way back up
Exercise B: [IMF-026 | Pallof Press] 3 sets of 12 reps each side, resist any rotation at the hips
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 4: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-114 | Hip Abduction Machine] 3 sets of 15 reps, controlled tempo throughout
Exercise B: [IMF-115 | Hip Adduction Machine] 3 sets of 15 reps, slow squeeze on the way in
Rest: 45 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
[IMF-118 | Standing Calf Raise] 3 sets of 15 reps, pause at the top and lower slowly, rest 45 seconds between sets
